beats.say: Play-Doh was invented to clean wallpaper.
Back in the 1930s, lots of homes were heated with coal.
And the soot turned wallpaper black.
So a company called Kutol made a soft dough to wipe it clean.
Then washable wallpaper came out, and sales crashed.
Until a teacher, Kay Zufall, let her class play with it.
In 1956, it became a toy called Play-Doh.
Billions of cans have been sold since.
